notes: /v1/systemone with the Jev-Style decision releases (Apache-2.0, Qwen3.5 fine-tunes with a
verdict readout), on one GCD and replicated over several. Objective (2) for decisions: the
engine runs one decision at a time per server (one worker, the decision held under a lock),
so latency under concurrency is queueing — measured here as wait_ms (the server's time minus
its decode time). That is the 'before' of batching decisions in the engine; replicas, one
server per GCD, are today's way to scale, and dec-replicas measures them.
Synthetic ticket histories and questions (bench/decision_bench.py), each state opened by its
own line so no request hits the state the server kept from the one before, and each asked
several times: consistency says whether concurrency changes an answer.
Q4_K_M, Q8_0 and F16 of each release, from the Hub, 06-10-2026: 0.8B 505/774/1446 MiB,
2B 1215/1919/3601 MiB. qwen3-0.6b (catalog) as the code-readout reference.
